Well Pump Repair in Roxboro, NC

Without a functional well pump, you lose complete access to water for your home. Well pump repairs require a sense of urgency because your home cannot go without a water source. Happy Home plumbers bring comprehensive knowledge of these systems and are qualified to deliver professional well pump repair services so water can flow back into your home once again.

Furnace Repair & Heat Pump Maintenance for Roxboro Winters

Roxboro sits at a higher elevation than most of the Triangle, so it receives more frozen precipitation and holds it longer than cities closer to Raleigh and Durham. That climate difference means homes in the area need a heating system that can handle the freezing temperatures winter brings.

Furnace Repair in Roxboro, NC

Fall in Roxboro is typically one of the most pleasant seasons of the year with limited HVAC use because the weather is simply perfect. We don’t really use our furnaces until the winter season comes in full swing. That means your furnace sits unused for almost half a year, leaving homeowners uncertain whether it is ready for peak usage. It’s common for furnace breakdowns to transpire at times when you need your system the most. When it’s the middle of winter and your furnace fails, Happy Home’s licensed HVAC technicians are ready to come to the rescue to get your system up and running again.

Heat Pump Maintenance in Roxboro, NC

A heat pump delivers both heating and cooling bundled into one unit. That means this system is being used non-stop year-round. Happy Home recommends having your heat pump maintenance conducted twice a year: once in the spring for a cooling checkup and once in the fall for a heating checkup. Our technicians will inspect your system and crucial components just before you begin switching from one mode to the other.

Whole-House Air Filtration for Roxboro Pollen and Dust

Pine and hardwood pollen plus agricultural dust can create a recipe for increased itching, sneezing, and allergen discomfort entering your home. Happy Home provides an extensive selection of indoor air quality solutions that require minimally invasive installation procedures. Depending on your air quality concerns, our licensed HVAC technicians can go over which systems are the best fit to meet your expectations.

Whole-House Air Filter in Roxboro, NC

Whole-house air filters are stronger and thicker filters that perform better than standard air filters. This single filter installs into your existing ductwork, trapping even smaller particles before they enter the rooms of your home.
